section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Personality as a Moderator', reports findings on the effects of personality traits on creativity and fluency. It highlights that Openness to experience had a significant main effect on creativity, while several traits including creative achievements, extraversion, conscientiousness, and agreeableness had main effects on fluency. Additionally, neuroticism was found to moderate the effect of 'be-creative' instructions on creativity.
